notes.title: Tales of Symphonia HD update and various fixes - Sept. 27th, 2016
notes.notes:
Hello Tales of Symphonia fans! A new update is live and features a handful of key fixes. Please see the full list below and thank you again for your support of Tales of Symphonia! 

- Increased resolution options up to 4K
- MSAA support
- Improved character and object outlines
- Frame rate smoothing
- Post sharpening and gamma improvements
- Improved mipmap implementation

Cheers,
-Bandai Namco Community Team"

notes.title: Tales of Symphonia Patch Notes - April 27th, 2016
notes.notes:
Hello Tales of Symphonia players! A new update is live featuring a handful of fixes. See below for the full list. And thank you again for your support of Tales of Symphonia! 
 
Cheers,
-Bandai Namco Community Team

[list]
[*]Remote Island Ranch did not allow players using Genis to successfully activate the sorcerers ring to change directions during the cart puzzle.
[*]Fixed crash at Welgaia when receiving the Chipped Dagger.
[*] Fixed game becoming unresponsive if game pad was unplugged during movement.
[*]Audio will now save based on the last save slot loaded.
[*]Sound Test should now be present on the main menu at all times if the last game a player loaded was NG+
[*]Blurriness double checked to ensure there were no left over instances of FXAA.  Post texture shaders were updated from linear, back to point.
[*]Updated credits.
[*]Various localization and corrupt text fixes throughout the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Tales of Symphonia - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Tales of Symphonia - Patch Notes (February 29th, 2016)[/h1]

We have a new update for Tales of Symphonia releasing today! (Available Now) See below for fixes and thank you to everyone for your support!

[u]Save / Load[/u]
[list]
[*]If you have a previous save game, the game will now default to selecting the “Load” option on the main menu.
[*]In the Load menu, your last saved slot should be selected.
[/list]
[u]PS3 Trigger Button Icons[/u]
[list]
[*]The Katz minigame in Izlood should now be displaying the proper trigger buttons.
[/list]

-Bandai Namco Community Team

notes.title: Tales of Symphonia - Patch Notes (2/5/2016)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone - Please see below for the latest patch notes. We definitely appreciate the feedback and are continuing to monitor these forums. Thank you for the support!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]                                                                                         
[b]Controller Button Icons[/b]
[list] 
[*]Addressed inconsistencies with legacy controller icons still showing up.
[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*]“Zelos Harem Master” legacy typo fixed in all languages.
[/list]

[b]Mouse Support[/b]
[list]
[*]Mouse Cursor icon hidden when in game
[/list]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
 
[b]Menu Localization[/b]
[list]
[*]Spanish & Italian switched in some menu options is now fixed.
[*]Previously missing Save & Load menu options are now localized with their corresponding prompts
[*]Exit Game menu option localization implemented
[*]Text alignment polish on Exit Game prompts
[*]Abbreviated some of the longer words in Keyboard Controls to avoid clipping with button textures.
[/list]

[h1]Additional Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some alignment and spacing issues still occur. Currently addressing.
[*]We are also actively working on resolving the false-positive with AVG software. We'll keep you updated with any further progress here on the Community Hub.
[/list]

notes.title: Tales of Symphonia - Patch Notes (2/2/2016)
notes.notes:
We thank you once again for your patience and understanding regarding the technical issues experienced with Tales of Symphonia. Our team was able to resolve the technical issues shown below.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Added VC++2013 redist to the installer config.
[*][i]Launching the game should allow this to install properly.[/i]
[*]Log File Writing error
[*][i]The game will no longer attempt to write to the C: drive.[/i]
[*]Save & Customize Menu delay (Windows 7)
[*][i]The save and customize menu should no longer delay 10 – 40 seconds upon opening.[/i][/list]

[b]Localization[/b][list]
[*]Implemented various localization fixes to the menu
[*]Relocated localization file
[*][i]No longer editable[/i]
[/list]
We will continue to remain diligent regarding technical issues and greatly appreciate your feedback.
